How We Respond

You’re already welcome here—this is posture, not a test of your tone.

We respond with clarity, humility, and accountability. We do not fuel outrage loops or argument theater.

Warmth without noise—this is how we try to speak.

Our stance

Today’s Daily Battle is a daily Scripture and prayer companion. The Word stays free. You do not have to give. We are a porch, not a replacement for a local church or a pastor.

Common questions

Why KJV?

KJV is stable, public-domain Scripture that allows broad free access. We add plain-meaning breakdowns for clarity, not doctrinal replacement.

Is data secure?

By default, prayers stay local to your device. Optional sign-in enables sync with role-based controls. See Privacy for details.

How does the porch stay open?

Everything is free. If people choose to give, or buy merch, that helps keep the lights on. The Word is never for sale. See Give and Where support goes.

Feedback

We read every message. Contact us at support email or through Contact. If we miss the mark, we correct and improve.
